reason: I desperately want real therapy, but an algorithm simulating empathy just feels hollow and fake. On my $17,000 college budget, I can't justify paying monthly for a bot when what I actually need is a human who cares.
objection: AI can't replace a real human therapist who actually cares.
would_change_my_mind: A hybrid option that connects me to affordable human student counselors alongside the coping tools.
